item: Climate fetches recorded per dataset and read back from Field data (row 265)
summary: Each climate fetch now records its outcome per dataset beside K13's successes: a failure is one fixed token (kill switch named as such, robots as robots, HTTP status, timeout, ...) and never an address, unit, station or server text. GET /api/climate/fetch-record feeds a new Field data file, and scripts/climate_readback.py prints the six datasets as fetched, failed (reason) or never tried, never an unread figure as 0.
